entries.18be46af171eff4e: The company provides high-precision reducers, centered on the Harmonic Drive® strain wave gearing, and mechatronics products such as actuators that combine motors, sensors, drivers and controllers. Its key features are compact size, light weight and high precision.
entries.21df9e7d465cb682: Makers of machine tools and measuring and testing equipment
entries.2a91faa4aacc7f89: The company operates precision reducer business as a single business, developing across four regions: Japan, China, North America and Europe. External revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was Japan ¥26,626 million, Europe ¥16,776 million, North America ¥12,107 million and China ¥4,046 million; by product, reducers were ¥46,333 million, accounting for 77.8% of the total, and mechatronics products were ¥13,224 million. There is no major counterparty accounting for 10% or more of revenue in the current consolidated fiscal year; in the previous consolidated fiscal year, Nissan Motor Co., Ltd. accounted for ¥5,733 million (10.3% of revenue).
entries.33c4186a34f47367: The company has formulated a medium-term management plan starting from fiscal 2026 (fiscal 2026 to fiscal 2030), titled "Value Creation and Challenge to Transformation," and positions "AI robotics," "aerospace, space and defense," and "e-mobility" as focus growth areas. In addition, the company states that it will work on strengthening marketing functions, improving new product creation and manufacturing capabilities, and strengthening its group-wide management foundation.
entries.51e7a190949ab03f: This is the region in which the local subsidiary in Shanghai is responsible for sales of reduction gears and mechatronics products and for technical services.
entries.523f6e362e4a53f7: Based on "Group strengths and features" in "Management policy, business environment and issues to be addressed" (accumulated technology and skills in strain wave gearing, product lineup, core technology, and business operations in which sales, manufacturing and development are integrated) and the product composition in "Business overview".
entries.5b67496962684668: The company identifies as its greatest strength the development technology, production technology, processing and assembly skills and production system accumulated over more than 50 years since its founding in strain wave gearing; Harmonic Drive®, which features compact size, light weight and high precision, holds a high share of the global market for joints of industrial robots and similar applications. Its core technology, which offers "Total Motion Control" combining reducers with motors, sensors, drivers and controllers, is also cited as a source of competitiveness. The structure in which the main sales, manufacturing and development departments are concentrated in Azumino, Nagano Prefecture, and carry out everything from inquiry to shipment as one unit, is also cited as a strength.

entries.6fa24b7abb098761: This is the region in which the local subsidiary in Shanghai is responsible for sales of reduction gears and mechatronics products and for technical services. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,046 million.
entries.7175b24827c38248: A precision reducer manufacturer that produces and sells strain wave gearing speed reducers and mechatronics products worldwide.
entries.756b2565d2de919c: This is the region in which Harmonic Drive SE of Germany and its consolidated subsidiaries are responsible for development and manufacturing and sell products in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, India and South America. entries.785ee26ddfe91471: This is a single business that produces and sells reduction gears such as strain wave gearing devices under the Harmonic Drive® name, and mechatronics products (actuators and control devices) that are applications of these reduction gears. The company, 17 consolidated subsidiaries and 2 equity-method affiliates make up 20 companies in total, and its products are used in a wide range of applications, including the joints of industrial robots, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, machine tools, artificial satellites, advanced medical devices and automotive applications. The reportable segments are divided by region of production and sales responsibility into 4 segments: Japan, China, North America and Europe.
entries.8945e5e7f2b7f7b6: This is the region where the company, its domestic subsidiaries and local subsidiaries in Asia excluding China are responsible for production and sales. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥26,626 million, the largest of the 4 regions.

entries.e3b9e84f31387859: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,608 million, a significant decrease from the previous consolidated fiscal year. The main factor was that, while consolidated revenue increased, income from factors separate from ordinary business activities, such as gains on sale of fixed assets and gains on sale of investment securities, decreased from the previous consolidated fiscal year.
